review_notes: I read all of Nodes48.lean. It holds 64 plain `def node30xx : Matrix (Fin 6) (Fin 4) ℤ := ![...]` data definitions. It has no theorems, simp lemmas, simp attributes, `@[simp]` unfoldings or rewrite rules, so there is no simp interface to evaluate in the file. I grepped for uses of node3072 and node3100. Downstream code unfolds them explicitly (`unfold ... node3072 ...; decide +kernel`) or uses `rfl` and `change`. I found no evidence of simp-based reasoning that needs these defs, and none of unwanted expansion, rewrite cycles or competing rules. Adding simp lemmas for individual entries would be speculative, and I don't recommend it. My only uncertainty is that I sampled uses and did not scan every consumer file.
